media: fixed 440Hz PCM/WAV synthetic device; real AudioContext decode and production RecordingPcm accumulation
native: IPC/window/quit/OCR/dialog/clipboard simulated; no OS/TCC/real microphone or Rust Store proof by default

checks: Body contains only the image preview trigger, no outside save or export status
Preview is a direct protected app child outside editor ancestors
Opening preview focuses its actual close control
Information uses authorized name, MIME, original byte length and natural image size with no invented timestamp
Tab wraps from close to information
Shift Tab wraps back to close
320px light reservedTop 0 keeps all header actions visible, nonoverlapping and no horizontal overflow
390px dark reservedTop 0 keeps all header actions visible, nonoverlapping and no horizontal overflow
800px light reservedTop 52 keeps all header actions visible, nonoverlapping and no horizontal overflow
800px dark reservedTop 52 keeps all header actions visible, nonoverlapping and no horizontal overflow
Close restores image trigger focus without changing editor JSON
Escape closes actual preview and returns focus
Opening/info/closing preview adds no Undo entry
Navigation closes preview and removes protected image bytes from overlay
Access prepare closes app-level preview synchronously under protected cover
All fallback blank header double clicks dispatch one simulated native toggle each
Fallback button/search/editor double clicks do not dispatch native zoom
Actual media source disposal synchronously hides overlay bytes and calls close once
native=false filtered drag helper never invokes a Tauri operation
No uncaught application page errors

limitations: Default IPC persistence and native quit/OCR/platform are explicit simulations; Rust Store/OS/TCC/hardware not proven.
Apple Notes has no HTML. This suite compares clone DOM/screenshots; original pixels require preserved manual reference assets.
Listed unsupported native menu features remain product limitations. Catalog availability is separate from scenario execution.
